title: Mobility Equipment Field Service Standard — Controller Handling by Loaner and Home-Assessment Records
content:
# Controller Handling Allowance — Mobility Equipment

A controller handling allowance is added to the labor units claimed from the manufacturer for a warranty joystick or controller replacement on a Mobility Equipment chair, by the chair's loaner and home-assessment records:

- **3 units** when no loaner chair has been delivered for the chair and two or more in-home accessibility assessments are recorded on it;
- **2 units** when no loaner chair has been delivered for it and exactly one in-home accessibility assessment is recorded;
- **nothing** in any other case.

## Input, judgement, output

| Loaner deliveries in the chair's service history | In-home accessibility assessments recorded on the chair | Controller handling allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 2 or more | 3 units |
| 0 | 1 | 2 units |
| 0 | 0 | none |
| 1 or more | any | none |

A loaner delivery is a delivery whose purpose is a loaner chair; every in-home accessibility assessment visit recorded on the chair counts, whatever it found.

## Hypothetical case

A power chair with one home assessment on file, repaired at the home with no loaner chair delivered: 2 units.
